🤖 When a patient asks AI about clinics near them, what does it actually read?

Some patients now read an AI summary or ask an assistant before they open a website. It can feel like a new race with secret rules. Mostly, it isn’t.

Google’s own guidance (Search Central, “AI features and your website”) says AI Overviews and AI Mode need no special optimisation beyond the fundamentals of search. The answer is built from what is already public about you.

What AI can read about your clinic:
1️⃣ Your website: one clear page per treatment, in plain words
2️⃣ Your Google profile: hours, services and location, kept current
3️⃣ The same details everywhere: name, address and phone that match
4️⃣ Questions patients ask, answered on your own site

✅ Nobody can promise you’ll be quoted by an AI, including us. What you control is whether the facts it finds are clear and correct.
